text:
maya (ml-eng): heads-up: FIN-Svc asked for a customer-specific instruct variant of our 65B model with 64k context and int8 quant. Wants GA-quality parity with their current hosted model and <200ms p95 for short prompts. Any blockers for onboarding?
aj (product): oof 64k + int8 + strict latency is a tricky mix. Do they need function-calling / structured outputs? what's expected qps / SLA? @nina FYI for compliance.
nina (cs): they're under SOC2 + some EU data rules. Private deploy is preferred but they asked for a dedicated pool first. Need an audit log and KMS.
serge (devex): checklist proposal: 1) model artifact + manifest 2) base vs instruct comparison bundle 3) quant sweep (int8/4 if feasible) 4) perf microbench (latency, memory) 5) quality evals (regression sets) 6) canary policy + fallback. I can stub a template.
maya (ml-eng): thanks. attaching quick config we tried locally: ```yaml
model: fin-65b-instruct
context_window: 65536
quant: int8
kv_cache: enabled
batching: auto
streaming: true
```
serge (devex): looks good. important to pin tokenizer + special tokens. also collect activation stats for quant calibration.
aj (product): priority? this is a revenue request but also compliance-heavy. Recommend P1 within eng-ml for 2-week bring-up, then dedicated capacity onboarding.
maya (ml-eng): plan for experiments: A) int8 static quant + calibration on 10k in-domain examples, B) int8 + selective fp16 attention kernels, C) fallback int16 variant. Quality metrics: exact-match for LFs, BERTScore, and a custom hallucination check.
nina (cs): make sure we capture consent metadata. we need to route logs to tenant-controlled bucket for private option.
serge (devex): benchmark script snippet: ```bash
# run perf
python perf_runner.py --model fin-65b-instruct --batch 1 --seq 128 --iters 200 --profile
``` collect p50/p95 and memory RSS. Aim p95 < 200ms for seq<=128.
maya (ml-eng): FYI early results: int8 calibration + kv cache reduced memory 28% but we see a 4.7pt drop on our in-domain QA exact-match vs baseline fp16 on some templates. Need targeted eval to find root cause.
aj (product): risk callout documented. Do we have variant gating? canary rollout + automatic revert if QA delta > 3 pts over baseline. That OK?
serge (devex): yep, implementable. canary config: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% with guard rails and fallback to fp16 variant. Use traffic-split + golden prompts.
maya (ml-eng): I'll run per-prompt failure analysis today, push a test eval set to /mnt/finserve_onboard/evals. owners: maya -> experiments, serge -> infra/canary, nina -> compliance checks.
aj (product): ETA?
maya (ml-eng): experiment sweep 3 days, follow-up report 1 day. so 4 days to recommend.
serge (devex): I'll prep dedicated pool sizing. Quick note: we should also test sequence trimming behavior for 64k; longctx memory patterns can affect KV layout.
nina (cs): will coordinate KMS/SC paperwork in parallel.
maya (ml-eng): action items: - maya: run quant calibration + targeted evals - serge: canary + deploy template, perf harness - nina: KMS / audit setup - aj: confirm SLA and QPS with customer
aj (product): I'll ping the account team now.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window created: finserve-onboard-canary, start=1768530000, duration=4h.
maya (ml-eng): great, thanks everyone. will post results in this thread. :rocket:
